description: Feature-First Clean Architecture (FFCA) orientation for Flutter monorepos: where code lives, layer boundaries, dependency rules, naming, and package organization. Use when working in an FFCA monorepo, a features/ folder whose packages are named {feature}_domain, {feature}_data, and {feature}_presentation, or when the user asks about Feature-First Clean Architecture, monorepo structure, layer dependencies, or package organization. Triggers on "where should this code live", "which package does this belong in", "is this dependency allowed", "can presentation import data", "can domain depend on Flutter", "what goes in {feature}_domain", "how should I name this package", and "explain the FFCA layers". If the repo instead uses packages/ with _repository and _api_client packages, defer to vgv-ai-flutter-plugin's layered-architecture skill.
